people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Ophrah
people.line: Gideon's hometown in Manasseh; a town in Issachar

translations.web: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
translations.bsb: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown. But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.
translations.kjv: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
translations.asv: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel played the harlot after it there; and it became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
